desc: The smallest and most portable in the line, the Bushnell A1 Binoculars slip easily into a daypack yet deliver bright, crisp views wherever you roam. Fully multi-coated optics maximize clarity and contrast, and EXO Barrier + IPX7 waterproofing keep lenses clear through rain or dust. With the SnapLok strap system for fast, secure carry, the A1 makes spontaneous adventure effortless — all backed by the Bushnell Lifetime Warranty.
